meanings.en: clearness of thought or expression
meanings.exampleEn: He explained the complex theory with remarkable lucidity.
meanings.exampleTr: Karmaşık teoriyi olağanüstü bir açıklıkla anlattı.

meanings.en: a period of being able to think clearly, especially during illness
meanings.exampleEn: In a moment of lucidity, she recognized her daughter.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir bilinç açıklığı anında kızını tanıdı.

meanings.en: a quiet period during a time of activity
meanings.exampleEn: There was a brief lull in the conversation.

meanings.en: to make someone calm or sleepy
meanings.exampleEn: The gentle music lulled the baby to sleep.

meanings.en: the quality of shining brightly or emitting light
meanings.exampleEn: The luminosity of the stars amazed the astronomers.

meanings.tr: toplu ödeme, tek seferde ödenen miktar
meanings.en: an amount of money paid all at once, not in installments
meanings.exampleEn: She received a lump sum when she retired.
meanings.exampleTr: Emekli olduğunda toplu bir ödeme aldı.

meanings.en: full of lumps; not smooth
meanings.exampleEn: The sauce was lumpy because it wasn't stirred enough.

meanings.tr: (internette) sessiz izleyici, katılmadan takip eden kişi
meanings.en: someone who reads online discussions without participating
meanings.exampleEn: Most members of the forum are lurkers who never post.
meanings.exampleTr: Forumun çoğu üyesi hiç yazmayan sessiz izleyicilerdir.

meanings.en: a person who waits or hides secretly
meanings.exampleEn: A lurker was spotted near the back entrance.
meanings.exampleTr: Arka girişin yakınında pusuda bekleyen biri fark edildi.

meanings.en: a gentle sheen or soft glow from a surface
meanings.exampleEn: The pearls had a beautiful luster.

meanings.en: glory, distinction, or prestige
meanings.exampleEn: The scandal took some of the luster off his reputation.

meanings.en: shining in a soft, gentle way
meanings.exampleEn: She had long, lustrous black hair.

meanings.en: the words of a song
meanings.exampleEn: The lyric of that song is really moving.

meanings.en: expressing personal emotions in a poetic way
meanings.exampleEn: He wrote a lyric poem about lost love.
meanings.exampleTr: Kayıp bir aşk üzerine lirik bir şiir yazdı.

meanings.en: a person who writes the words for songs
meanings.exampleEn: She is a talented lyricist who has written for many pop stars.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok pop yıldızı için yazmış yetenekli bir şarkı sözü yazarıdır.

meanings.en: a raincoat (British informal, short for mackintosh)
meanings.exampleEn: Take your mac; it looks like rain.
meanings.exampleTr: Yağmurluğunu al; yağmur yağacak gibi görünüyor.

meanings.tr: asıl kaygı, temel endişe, öncelikli mesele
meanings.en: the most important worry or issue
meanings.exampleEn: Safety is our main concern on this project.

meanings.en: the central or principal office of a company
meanings.exampleEn: All important decisions are made at the main office.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün önemli kararlar merkez ofiste alınır.

meanings.en: the most important idea in a discussion or text
meanings.exampleEn: Let me summarize the main point of the article.

meanings.tr: ana hikaye örgüsü, esas olay akışı
meanings.en: the central plot of a story, film, or book
meanings.exampleEn: The main storyline follows a detective solving a murder.
meanings.exampleTr: Ana hikaye örgüsü, bir cinayeti çözen dedektifi takip eder.

meanings.en: the main part of a country, not including its islands
meanings.exampleEn: They took a ferry from the island to the mainland.

meanings.en: impressively beautiful, grand, or dignified
meanings.exampleEn: We admired the majestic mountains in the distance.

meanings.tr: telafi etmek, gönül almak, kusurunu düzeltmek
meanings.en: to do something to correct a wrong you have done
meanings.exampleEn: He tried to make amends by apologizing to everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesten özür dileyerek telafi etmeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: a failure to work correctly
meanings.exampleEn: A technical malfunction delayed the flight.

meanings.en: to fail to work in the normal way
meanings.exampleEn: The engine began to malfunction during the trip.

meanings.en: intended to harm or upset someone
meanings.exampleEn: He spread malicious rumors about his colleague.
meanings.exampleTr: Meslektaşı hakkında kötü niyetli söylentiler yaydı.

meanings.en: (of a tumor) likely to spread and cause death
meanings.exampleEn: Tests showed the tumor was malignant.

meanings.en: showing a strong desire to harm someone
meanings.exampleEn: There was a malignant look in his eyes.

meanings.en: able to be bent or shaped easily without breaking
meanings.exampleEn: Gold is a highly malleable metal.
meanings.exampleTr: Altın son derece dövülebilir bir metaldir.

meanings.en: easily influenced or changed
meanings.exampleEn: Young children have malleable minds.

meanings.en: cruel or violent treatment of a person or animal
meanings.exampleEn: The charity works to prevent the maltreatment of animals.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayır kurumu hayvanlara kötü muameleyi önlemek için çalışıyor.

meanings.en: neatly trimmed and carefully cared for
meanings.exampleEn: The house had a beautifully manicured lawn.
meanings.exampleTr: Evin güzelce bakımlı bir çimenliği vardı.

meanings.en: (of nails) treated with a manicure
meanings.exampleEn: She showed off her perfectly manicured nails.

meanings.tr: kasıtsız adam öldürme, taksirle ölüme sebebiyet
meanings.en: the crime of killing someone without intending to
meanings.exampleEn: He was convicted of manslaughter rather than murder.
meanings.exampleTr: Cinayetten değil, kasıtsız adam öldürmeden mahkum edildi.

meanings.en: to spoil or damage something
meanings.exampleEn: The celebration was marred by violence.

meanings.en: very small in amount or importance
meanings.exampleEn: There was only a marginal improvement in sales.
meanings.exampleTr: Satışlarda yalnızca çok küçük bir iyileşme oldu.

meanings.en: relating to the change from one additional unit
meanings.exampleEn: The marginal cost of producing one more unit is low.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir birim daha üretmenin marjinal maliyeti düşüktür.

meanings.en: a drug made from the cannabis plant
meanings.exampleEn: Marijuana is legal in several U.S. states.

meanings.en: a sailor (formal or literary)
meanings.exampleEn: The old mariner told tales of distant seas.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı denizci uzak denizlerin hikayelerini anlattı.

meanings.en: a situation where asset prices rise far above their real value before crashing
meanings.exampleEn: Many investors lost money when the market bubble burst.
meanings.exampleTr: Piyasa balonu patladığında birçok yatırımcı para kaybetti.

meanings.en: the killing of a large number of people at one time
meanings.exampleEn: The dictator was responsible for the mass murder of civilians.

meanings.en: public transport systems that move large numbers of people
meanings.exampleEn: The city is investing in mass transit to reduce traffic.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir, trafiği azaltmak için toplu taşımaya yatırım yapıyor.

meanings.en: a person trained to give massages for health or relaxation
meanings.exampleEn: The massage therapist helped ease the tension in my back.

meanings.en: an artist's or writer's greatest work
meanings.exampleEn: This novel is considered his masterwork.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu roman onun başyapıtı olarak kabul edilir.

meanings.en: the state of being married; marriage (formal)
meanings.exampleEn: They were joined in holy matrimony.

meanings.en: the quality of behaving in a sensible, adult way
meanings.exampleEn: She handled the situation with great maturity.
meanings.exampleTr: Durumu büyük bir olgunlukla ele aldı.

meanings.en: the time when a financial investment becomes due for payment
meanings.exampleEn: The bond reaches maturity in ten years.
meanings.exampleTr: Tahvil on yıl içinde vadesine ulaşır.

meanings.en: a pale purple color
meanings.exampleEn: She wore a mauve dress to the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Partiye leylak renkli bir elbise giydi.

meanings.en: a short statement expressing a general truth or rule of conduct
meanings.exampleEn: He lived by the maxim 'honesty is the best policy'.
meanings.exampleTr: 'Dürüstlük en iyi politikadır' özdeyişine göre yaşadı.

meanings.en: as great or large as possible
meanings.exampleEn: The team aimed for maximal efficiency in production.

meanings.en: used to say that something is possible
meanings.exampleEn: It may rain later this afternoon.

meanings.en: used to ask for or give permission
meanings.exampleEn: May I leave the room?

meanings.tr: beni, bana (birinci tekil şahıs nesne zamiri)
meanings.en: the object form of 'I', referring to the speaker
meanings.exampleEn: Can you give me the book?

meanings.en: very small in amount and not enough
meanings.exampleEn: They survived on a meager income.

meanings.en: having no meaning, purpose, or importance
meanings.exampleEn: Without context, the numbers are completely meaningless.

meanings.en: able to be measured; large enough to be noticed
meanings.exampleEn: The project produced measurable results within a month.
meanings.exampleTr: Proje bir ay içinde ölçülebilir sonuçlar üretti.

meanings.en: an instrument used to measure something
meanings.exampleEn: A ruler is a simple measuring tool.
